column5: Recurring charges hidden behind ads.  Extremely misleading and unacceptable billing practices.  The advertising makes users believe they are paying a very small amount, while in reality they are being enrolled into expensive recurring monthly charges without fully realizing it. Before you understand what is happening, substantial amounts of money can be taken from your account over time.  Unless you constantly monitor your card transactions, it is very easy not to notice the recurring charges immediately. There are no meaningful warnings that make the long-term financial commitment truly clear from a normal consumer perspective.  When customers eventually realize what has happened and ask for their money back, the company simply hides behind refund policies and subscription terms instead of acknowledging how misleading the entire payment flow feels.  Based on my experience, this does not feel like an honest or transparent subscription model. It feels intentionally designed to confuse users into ongoing payments they never clearly intended to authorize.  Be extremely careful before clicking on advertisements or entering your payment details.
